brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Something to keep sewing supplies tidy (storage that separates items)
requirements.evidence: A full hex base (piece:0,0,0) holds a 3-compartment full-depth bin (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3) that separates small items, with solid caps on the base's open faces. A pencil stands in one compartment as a stand-in for a tailor's pencil.

requirements.requirement: Sized for sewing supplies (spools, needles, buttons, scissors)
requirements.evidence: The compartments are generic; the catalog has no sewing-specific props, so the pencil and a marker were only trial props. Only one pencil is placed; the marker was refused for fit. Spools and scissors are not in the catalog.

finish.summary: Built a single hex base with a three-compartment bin and solid end caps on its open faces, so small sewing items can be sorted into separate sections. The configurator check is clear with no issues. The catalog has no sewing-specific items, so the layout is generic storage; I placed one pencil as a prop. The build is one cell, so for more capacity more bases would be needed.
